transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… I came in because most days I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. Like the old me—Ruben, the guy who could talk to anybody and get through the day fine—he’s just… not there anymore.
Did this heavy, empty feeling start after something stressful happened in your life?
Yeah… I guess it did. It’s been about eight months. Around when the new regional manager started… coming down on me, taking accounts I’d had for years.
When you're away from work, does that heavy, empty feeling ease up?
Not really. Even when I’m not there, I wake up with that same hollow feeling… like I’m just not myself anymore.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about many different things, even when there isn’t a clear reason to?
I don’t know… not really in that way, I guess. It’s more just this feeling that’s there. I’m not sure I’d call it worrying about everything.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah… I have. I used to look forward to things like bowling, messing around in the garden, taking my wife to gallery shows… even dancing sometimes. Now I mostly just sit there and make excuses. None of it feels worth the effort.
Before these past eight months, had you already been feeling down or empty most days for at least two years?
No… not for two years. It’s more like these last eight months, since that new regional manager started… you know, coming down on me and pulling accounts I’d had for years.
Before these past eight months, was there ever another time in your life when you felt this same kind of depression for weeks at a time?
I don’t think so. I mean… I’ve had bad stretches like anyone, but not like this for weeks at a time.
Do these feelings seem stronger than what you'd expect from the problems at work?

Yeah… I think so. Work’s been bad, but this feels bigger than that. Most days I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling in my chest… like the old me, the guy who could talk to anybody and get through the day, is just… gone.
For the past two weeks, have you felt down or empty nearly every day?
Yeah… pretty much every day. I wake up with that heavy, hollow feeling in my chest, like the old me is just… not there anymore.
Has this been making it hard for you to function at work or at home?

Yeah… it has. I missed an important client presentation, which isn’t like me. And at home I’ve kind of… pulled away so much that my wife got scared, I guess. She felt like she had to bring me in because I wasn’t safe just carrying on like this.
Have you had thoughts about killing yourself?

Yeah… I’ve had thoughts like that. Not exactly… I don’t know. I keep thinking maybe my wife and kids would be better off if I just didn’t wake up. And that scares me, because I don’t trust myself like I used to.
